issue_context.title: Direct usage of `core-js-compat`
comments: @kdy1 please, take a look at this since at this moment [is used](https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/2462b9941f94bc475cf9ff9c67e3b7c1f98739cc/crates/swc_ecma_preset_env/src/corejs3/modules-by-versions.json) critically obsolete compact data from `core-js@3.6` - 2019.12.19 - 2 years old.

I don't believe use core-js-compat as a dependency would be a good idea -- it would cause much trouble in wasm. However, I believe it's good to include_str core-js-compat directly since it will always reside in node_modules/core-js-compat. @kdy1 what's your opinion?
@Austaras  I think you are right, it will make updating much easier.
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.
